\# Billed until property on subscription items is no longer included in responses by default

\## What’s new

You must now \[expand\](https://docs.stripe.com/expand.md#includable-properties) the \[billed\_until\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/object.md?api-version=2026-05-27.preview#subscription\_object-items-data-billed\_until) property on subscription items if you want to include it in the response. This makes subscription API methods more performant in cases where it isn’t requested.

\## Why is this a breaking change?

If your integration references the \`billed\_until\` property on subscription items, you now need to expand it in your request to include it in the response. Previously, it was included by default.

\## Impact

Requests that don’t need \`billed\_until\` execute quicker. This is most notable on API methods that can return multiple subscriptions in one request, such as \[list\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/list.md?api-version=2026-05-27.preview).

For requests that do need \`billed\_until\`, \[expand\](https://docs.stripe.com/expand.md#includable-properties) the property in your request.

Learn more about \[expanding resources\](https://docs.stripe.com/expand.md) and \[configuring prebilling for subscriptions\](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/prebilling.md).

\## Changes

\#### REST API

\| Field \| Change \| From → to \|
\| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \|
\| \`SubscriptionItem.billed\_until\` \| Changed \| \`nullable(DateTime) → DateTime\` \|

\#### Ruby

\| Field \| Change \| From → to \|
\| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \|

\#### Python

\#### PHP

\#### Java

This change doesn’t affect the Java SDK.

\#### Node.js

\| Field \| Change \| From → to \|
\| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \|
\| \`SubscriptionItem.billed\_until\` \| Changed \| \`DateTime \| null → DateTime\` \|

\#### Go

This change doesn’t affect the Go SDK.

\#### .NET

\| Field \| Change \| From → to \|
\| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \| \-\-\- \|
\| \`SubscriptionItem.BilledUntil\` \| Changed \| \`nullable(DateTime) → DateTime\` \|

\## Upgrade

\#### REST API

1\. \[View your current API version\](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2\. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
 \- If you don’t use an SDK, update your \[API requests\](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include \`Stripe-Version: 2026-05-27.preview\`
3\. Upgrade the API version used for \[webhook endpoints\](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4\. \[Test your integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5\. If you use Connect, \[test your Connect integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about \[Stripe API upgrades\](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).
